articles.summary: Commerce Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: CBSH) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.275 per share on the Company's common stock. The dividend is payable on December 21, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on December 1, 2026. The Board of Directors also approved a 5% common stock dividend payable on December 22, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 1, 2026. Statements reflecting the issuance of shares as a result of the stock dividend should be mailed on or about December 22, 2026. No fractional shares will be issued, and shareholders will receive cash for such fractional interests based on the market value of the stock on the record date. The quarterly cash dividend will not be payable on any shares to be issued pursuant to the 5% stock dividend. About Commerce Bancshares, Inc. Commerce Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: CBSH) is a regional bank holding company with $34.8 billion in assets¹, offering
articles.title: Commerce Bancshares, Inc. Declares Stock Dividend and Quarterly Cash Dividend on Common Stock

articles.summary: Commerce Bank today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Nolan Associates, a St. Louis-based boutique investment banking firm serving middle-market clients nationwide. The acquisition adds investment banking capabilities and enhances its ability to support business owners through growth, acquisition, capital-raising and ownership transition decisions. "We are pleased to welcome Nolan Associates to Commerce," said Bob Holmes, chairman and chief executive officer, Commerce Bank – St. Louis. "Nolan has built an outstanding reputation for trusted advice, deep industry knowledge and long-term client relationships. Their addition strengthens our ability to serve middle-market companies and business owners with a broader range of strategic and financial advisory services."
